description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Inspired Eclipse: when you give Bardic Inspiration, the module offers to make you Invisible (until the start of your next turn, or until you attack, deal damage or cast a spell) and make your next move a teleport of up to 30 ft. Lunar Vitality: once per turn when you restore HP with a spell, the module offers to spend a Bardic Inspiration die and add its roll; the creature's Speed also increases by 10 ft until the end of its next turn.

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Inspired Eclipse after Bardic Inspiration and Lunar Vitality on spell healing (module).
